name: Argilla
tagline: The intelligence layer beneath every acre you own.
positioning: Argilla turns raw core samples and sensor telemetry into a living map of soil health — so enterprise agronomy teams stop guessing what's underground.

hero.h1: Every layer of your soil, finally on the record.
hero.sub: Argilla unifies lab cores, in-field probes, and satellite indices into one interrogable model of what's actually happening beneath your operation — down to the horizon.

features.title: Core-to-cloud ingestion
features.description: Pipe lab results, LoRa moisture probes, and NDVI passes into one schema. No more reconciling three spreadsheets and a PDF from the testing lab.

features.title: Horizon-level modeling
features.description: We reconstruct each soil profile layer by layer, so your agronomists reason about the O, A, and B horizons instead of a single blended average.

features.title: Carbon-grade audit trail
features.description: Every reading is timestamped, geo-locked, and versioned to survive a verifier's scrutiny — the artifact your carbon program actually asks for.

features.title: Yield-risk forecasting
features.description: Argilla flags compaction, salinity, and nutrient drift weeks before they show up in a harvest report you can't undo.

features.title: Fleet-wide benchmarking
features.description: Compare 40,000 acres across regions on the same axis. Find the outlier quarter-section dragging your whole basin down.

features.title: Sampling that plans itself
features.description: Argilla proposes the next round of core sites to shrink uncertainty fastest — so your field crews stop over-sampling the easy corners.

testimonials.quote: We used to wait six weeks for lab PDFs, then hand-key them into a legacy GIS. Argilla collapsed that into a dashboard our whole agronomy desk trusts before the field crew is back to the truck.
testimonials.name: Dana Okafor

testimonials.quote: The horizon-level modeling is the part our carbon verifier stopped arguing with. It's the first soil dataset we've handed over that didn't come back with a page of questions.
testimonials.name: Henrik Vasser

testimonials.quote: Argilla told us which 300 acres were quietly compacting a full season before yield would have. That single flag paid for the contract three times over.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
